content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. content_sections.text: Senior Software/System/Network Engineer (Grade-I): First class ME/M.Tech/M.S. degree or equivalent in Computer Science and Engineering/ Information Technology or equivalent from a recognized University/Institute of repute and at least 6 years' of relevant experience in the relevant areas out of which 2 years in the Grade Pay of '6600/- or equivalent level OR First class B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc degree or equivalent in Computer Science and Engineering/ Information Technology or MCA or equivalent from a recognized University/Institute of repute and at least 8 years' of relevant experience in the relevant areas out of which 2 years in the Grade Pay of '6600/- or equivalent level. Senior Software/System/Network Engineer (Grade-II): First class BE/B.Tech/M.Sc. degree or equivalent in Computer Science and Engineering/ Information Technology or equivalent or MCA from a recognised University/Institute of repute and at least 5 years' relevant experience out of which 3 years in Level 10 of Pay Matrix '56100-177500/- (Pre-revised : PB-3, GP of '5400/-) or equivalent level. Software/System/Network Engineer: First class B.E. /B. Tech /MSc. Degree or equivalent in Computer Science and Engineering or Information Technology or equivalent or MCA from a recognised University/Institute of repute and at least 2 years of relevant experience.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Kharagpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kharagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Software/System/Network Engineer posts is 17 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Software/System/Network Engineer posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies for the Software/System/Network Engineer (various grades) positions as per the official notification released by IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a First class B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc. degree or equivalent in Computer Science and Engineering or Information Technology or equivalent or MCA from a recognised University/Institute of repute, along with relevant experience as specified for each post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Software/System/Network Engineer positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 56100 to Rs. 209200 Per Month, depending on the specific grade and level of the position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 1000. SC/ST and Women candidates have to pay Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a Screening Test, Written Test, Presentation, Group Discussion, Personal Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India norms for candidates belonging to reserved categories.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications for IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online only through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located in Kharagpur, West Bengal, at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur campus.
